sql: SELECT specieskey AS gbif_species_key, GBIF_DMSGCode(1800, decimalLatitude, decimalLongitude, COALESCE(coordinateUncertaintyInMeters, 1000)) AS global_gridcell, "year" AS obs_year, "month" AS obs_month, COUNT(*) AS n_gbif_occurrences FROM occurrence WHERE specieskey IN (1037977, 1038074, 1421964, 1425139, 1427883, 1427951, 1428311, 1428334, 1429172, 1429340, 2007557, 2007580, 2007585, 2007586, 2227289, 2362460, 2422872, 2422924, 2423435, 2426654, 2426661, 2426760, 2426805, 2427072, 2427110, 2427185, 2427573, 2427610, 2428130, 2428182, 2430567, 2431776, 2431783, 2431824, 2431885, 2431887, 2431913, 2431943, 2431993, 2710941, 2711157, 2717002, 2718307, 4469860, 4470284, 4470286, 4470294, 4644515, 4778118, 5051506, 5051741, 5178605, 5202187, 5216933, 5217160, 5217504, 5218022, 5218405, 5218406, 5218408, 5218409, 5218410, 5289423, 5289461, 5290149, 5753548, 5974802, 10806364, 10810025, 10843277, 10863553) AND hascoordinate = TRUE AND hasgeospatialissues = FALSE AND occurrencestatus = 'PRESENT' AND "year" >= 2010 AND "year" <= 2026 AND (coordinateUncertaintyInMeters IS NULL OR coordinateUncertaintyInMeters <= 10000) GROUP BY specieskey, GBIF_DMSGCode(1800, decimalLatitude, decimalLongitude, COALESCE(coordinateUncertaintyInMeters, 1000)), "year", "month"
